title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Ages
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Soniya got married 15 years ago. Her present age is 8/5 times her age at the time of her marriage. Her sister was 8 years younger to her at the time of her marriage. Find the present age of her sister.
questions.explain: Let Soniya's present age be $S$. Her age at marriage was $S - 15$. We have $S = \frac{8}{5}(S - 15) \Rightarrow 5S = 8S - 120 \Rightarrow 3S = 120 \Rightarrow S = 40$. Soniya's age at marriage was $40 - 15 = 25$ years. Her sister was $25 - 8 = 17$ years old then. The sister's present age is $17 + 15 = 32$ years.
